additional_maintenance_row_unchanged.subject: thm-cm-burgers-riemann-shock-and-rarefaction
additional_maintenance_row_unchanged.detail: Published Burgers proof step 1.2 and step 4.1 wrongly confine the difference from the initial step to [u_L epsilon,u_R epsilon]. For u_L=1,u_R=2 and 0<x<epsilon the profile is 1 and the datum 2. Enlarge to [min(0,u_L epsilon),max(0,u_R epsilon)] of length at most (|u_L|+|u_R|)epsilon; boundedness still proves convergence. Local Riemann step 4.2 and Burgers fan use the correct estimate, so no owned conclusion is blocked. Published owner repair remains required.
